scripts.build-shared-crag: npm install --prefix packages/shared-crag && npm run build --prefix packages/shared-crag
scripts.build-shared-firebase: npm install --prefix packages/shared-firebase && npm run build --prefix packages/shared-firebase
scripts.dev: npm run build-shared-crag && npm run dev --prefix crag-explorer
scripts.dev:api: npm run build-shared-crag && npm run build-shared-firebase && npm run dev --prefix crag-api
scripts.test:api: npm run build-shared-crag && npm test --prefix crag-api
scripts.emulator:start: npm install --prefix packages/shared-firebase && npm run emulator:start --prefix packages/shared-firebase
scripts.build: npm run build-shared-crag && npm ci --prefix crag-explorer && npm run build --prefix crag-explorer
